name: Rocket Blast - 1g Cart - Fritter Frenzy
description:
Sweet, warm, and bakery-fresh. The Rocket Blast Fritter Frenzy cartridge holds 1 gram of premium distillate in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery — simple, reliable, and made to last.

Fritter Frenzy serves up that fresh-out-the-oven apple fritter flavor: sweet baked apple and warm cinnamon-sugar notes with a smooth, glazed-pastry finish. It's a rich, dessert-forward profile made for anyone who likes their sessions sweet, cozy, and full of flavor.

Why you'll love it:

1G of premium distillate — smooth, potent, and consistent
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Fritter Frenzy flavor — sweet baked apple and cinnamon sugar with a glazed finish
Reliable performance — flavorful, even pulls from first to last

Rich flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Rocket Blast Fritter Frenzy is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
